req.title: Player payload includes firstName and lastName
req.statement: The system shall include firstName and lastName fields on every player response.
triggers: player payload includes firstname and lastname

doc.reasoning: R-PLAYER-033 requires that every player response includes firstName and lastName fields. The PlayerResponseModel uses camelCase aliasing (to_camel), so the JSON keys are 'firstName' and 'lastName'. Tests must: (1) positively confirm both fields are present and non-null for a known player, (2) confirm exact field values match the seeded data, (3) test a boundary player (first and last in the dataset), (4) confirm a missing/invalid player ID returns 4xx (negative path), and (5) assert the fields are strings with exact values to catch field-name mutations, key-removal mutations, and value-swap mutations.

tests.name: test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive
preconditions: Player with id 97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802 exists (Anjali Banerjee, squad 1)
expected: Response JSON contains key 'firstName' with value 'Anjali'
Response JSON contains key 'lastName' with value 'Banerjee'
trace: R-PLAYER-033: every player response must include firstName and lastName
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_player_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName_positive():
    r = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert 'firstName' in body
    assert 'lastName' in body
    assert body['firstName'] == 'Anjali'
    assert body['lastName'] == 'Banerjee'
    assert isinstance(body['firstName'], str)
    assert isinstance(body['lastName'], str)

tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_all_players_response_includes_firstName_and_lastName():
    r = client.get('/players/')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    players = r.json()
    assert len(players) == 26
    for p in players:
        assert 'firstName' in p, f"firstName missing for player {p.get('id')}"
        assert 'lastName' in p, f"lastName missing for player {p.get('id')}"
        assert isinstance(p['firstName'], str)
        assert isinstance(p['lastName'], str)
        assert p['firstName'] != ''
        assert p['lastName'] != ''
